note: Delete the probe alert — confirm:true is the documented operator-consent flag.

response.guide: Check deleted first. deleted=false means nothing was deleted yet: present the returned alert to the user as the confirmation step (this preview replaces any confirmation you would compose yourself — never ask twice), then call delete_alert again with confirm=true once they approve. deleted=true means the alert is permanently gone: confirm that to the user from the returned alert field — it is the alert exactly as stored before deletion. If the alert_id is unknown the call fails in either phase and nothing is deleted: re-read get_alerts to find the right id. Deletion is permanent; the only way back is create_alert with the same condition. Existing get_alert_log entries are historical events and are NOT removed with the setting. An alert is informational only — deleting it never affects orders or positions.
